title: Follow-up on forked DXF candidate and ACIS renderer evidence boundary
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and plan refinement
scope: Re-audit the already inventoried open-source DXF reader/writer and sharpen its source-lineage limits
Inspect its DWG checking/conversion path for independent evidence value
Separate a documented ACIS/SAB edge projection from full B-rep semantics
Clarify optional peer admission without changing implementation order or validation cadence

sources.observation: The README declares text/binary DXF read/write from R12 to AC1032 and lists typed entity/model families plus UnknownEntity raw group-code retention. It explicitly identifies the project as a fork of ixmilia/dxf-go. The UnknownEntity API docs warn application group 102 and some OBJECTS references may not survive writing. The indexed v0.3.3 page says that version is not the latest module version; no package was downloaded, and no immutable current source commit was resolved or run.

The package README says cmd/dxfcheck converts DWG and DWG xrefs with LibreDWG dwg2dxf and checks conversion against DWG entity counts using LibreDWG tools, including dwgread. This is useful as a conversion omission diagnostic but does not provide an independent DWG implementation or semantic oracle.
The README identifies ProCad.IO as ACadSharp-backed DWG/DXF load/save. It is an ACadSharp-derived application/consumer route, not an independent DWG/DXF codec.

The architecture document states that ACadSharp owns the file-format object model; this assigns ProGPU's primary drawing IO route to ACadSharp lineage. The document was read but the repository was not cloned or executed.

sources.project: ProGPU DXF and SAB technical document
sources.observation: The document describes AcisSabParser scanning raw SAB tokens, isolating edge records, tracing vertices to points, and emitting Acis3dEdge start/end pairs for projection. The reviewed description does not establish full shell/face/loop/coedge/surface semantics, B-rep validity, solid operations, or analytic expected-volume validation. This is an edge-projection research lead only.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Refined the existing PAR-07/S8 optional comparator route ledger: kedazo/dxf-go is an IxMilia-derived DXF-only route; its DWG diagnostics depend on LibreDWG; ProCad/ProGPU drawing IO is ACadSharp-backed; and ProGPU's documented SAB path is limited to edge projection evidence. No local defect or support claim was added.
planImpact.nextImplementation: Continue the existing local-ready implementation queue. No peer run, dependency, or external qualification prerequisite is added.

method.limitations: GitHub and pkg.go.dev pages are mutable documentation snapshots. The exact latest kedazo/dxf-go package-to-commit mapping was not established and no package was downloaded or run. ProGPU's SAB description is a project-authored algorithm scope document, not an independent validation result.
